text: SoftBank falls 14.83%, Advantest 12.94%, Tokyo Electron 12.53%, SK Hynix 11.05% and Samsung 9.87%. Nvidia declines 4.65% premarket. European technology losses remain near 1%, while broader European indexes rise and U.S. defensive sectors register gains.

meta.note: Reported equity movements span different trading sessions and intraday measurement points.
